description: Intake queue for new GTA VI predictions. Add entries here — never directly to predictions.json. The nightly fetch_predictions_auto.py run promotes each pending draft into a proposal card on /admin/proposals/ for human review before it lands in predictions.json.
workflow: 1. Add new prediction draft here (all required fields from predictions.json schema v2.0)
2. Keep draft_status 'needs_review' (ignored by CI) until a human sets confidence_tier; then set 'pending' — note fetch_predictions_auto.py auto-publishes 'pending' drafts that pass its quality gate
3. Nightly CI promotes it to a proposal on /admin/proposals/
4. Reviewer copies the draft into predictions.json and removes/updates this entry
5. Set draft_status to 'promoted' here (or delete the entry) after applying

drafts.title: Context-sensitive NPC interactions affect mission access and pricing
drafts.unit: Reported from community sources — ties to honour pricing
drafts.basis: RDR2's greet/antagonize system (hold/tap near NPCs) gave Arthur honour points that unlocked dialogue branches and changed shop prices. Community sources report a direct analogue in GTA VI tied to Lucia and Jason's reputation in different regions. Economically, this creates a dynamic pricing layer over the base GTA$ system — the first time franchise pricing has been protagonist-behaviour-dependent.
drafts.source: Community insider reports + RDR2 mechanic precedent
drafts.prediction_method: RDR2 mechanic transfer analysis — greet/antagonize → reputation → pricing
drafts.draft_notes: Supported by mechanics/index.json greet-antagonize entry + shop-prices honour_price_modifier data

drafts.title: GTA VI will have a Trader-style supply and sell passive income cycle
drafts.unit: Based on RDR Online Trader role — $625 per full sell run
drafts.basis: RDR Online's Trader role (Butcher's Table) is the closest structural precedent to GTA Online's Bunker and MC businesses — supply materials, process product, sell for profit on a 2-hour cycle. Community sources report GTA VI Online will have a resource/goods trading layer in the Leonida economy. The Trader role earned RDR$625 per full delivery, which at franchise income scaling maps to GTA$800K–$1.2M/hr in a GTA VI context.
drafts.source: RDR Online role precedent + community insider reports
drafts.prediction_method: RDR Online Trader income scaled by franchise income inflation rate (GTA V → VI)
drafts.draft_notes: Supported by online-roles.json Trader entry with gta_vi_analogue field

drafts.title: Eagle Eye threat detection mechanic carries forward into GTA VI
drafts.unit: Reported — direct RDR2 Eagle Eye evolution
drafts.basis: RDR2's Eagle Eye (hold R3) highlighted threats, tracks, herbs and collectibles in the environment. GTA V had a limited heightened sense (special ability). Community sources report GTA VI introduces a sustained threat-detection mode for both protagonists — spotting ambushes, tracking targets, and identifying loot containers. Economically, this reduces time-cost of ambient income (looting, hunting) and changes the risk/reward calculation for wanted-level missions.
drafts.source: Community insider reports + RDR2 Eagle Eye mechanic precedent

prediction_range.high: Full Eagle Eye clone with tracking and loot detection

drafts.prediction_method: RDR2 mechanic transfer analysis — Eagle Eye → GTA VI threat detection

drafts.title: GTA VI will have a collectible circuit income tier
drafts.unit: Based on RDR Online Collector role — avg $250 per full set
drafts.basis: RDR Online's Collector role (Madam Nazar) monetised world exploration by turning ambient collectibles into income. 9 full sets worth ~$400 each. GTA Online had hidden packages and collectibles but no income system attached. The GTA VI world — spanning two distinct territories — has the geographic complexity to support a collectible economy. This would be the franchise's first income-generating exploration mechanic, filling the 'ambient explorer' player niche.
drafts.source: RDR Online Collector role precedent + GTAVI.AI economic model

prediction_range.high: Full collector circuit — GTA$200K–$500K/hr for active hunters

drafts.prediction_method: RDR Online Collector income scaled to GTA VI income ceiling + exploration complexity estimate
drafts.draft_notes: Supported by online-roles.json Collector entry with gta_vi_analogue field

drafts.title: GTA VI PC Release by End of Q1 2027
drafts.basis: GamesBeat cites four industry sources with business ties to Rockstar saying the PC version targets Q1 2027; VGC's Andy Robinson earlier reported industry 'noise' about the PC date being pulled forward. Rockstar has not announced a PC version. GTA V reached PC 19 months after console and RDR2 13 months after; a 2–4 month gap would be a sharp break, consistent with Take-Two's stated PC growth focus.
drafts.source: GamesBeat (via Rockstar Intel, Oct 13 2026) + VGC + franchise port history
drafts.prediction_method: Source-weighted report + franchise console-to-PC gap history
drafts.draft_notes: Suggested tier: reported. Human sets confidence_tier and flips draft_status to 'pending' only when ready to publish — 'pending' drafts that pass the quality gate are auto-published by fetch_predictions_auto.py. Promoted 2026-10-23 as reported (owner review).

drafts.title: Radio Stations at Launch
drafts.basis: Rockstar calls GTA VI's lineup 'the biggest and widest-ranging selection of in-game radio and podcasts yet', spanning classic rock to talk radio. Six music stations are previewed so far (Cocoteo FM, Back Country Radio, AfroBank FM, The Chamber 106.6, Flash FM, Dirty South Classics). GTA V launched with 17 stations (15 music + 2 talk) and grew past 20 through updates, so 'biggest yet' points to at least that at launch, with podcasts as a separate on-demand layer.
drafts.source: Rockstar Games — The Music of GTA VI (Oct 8 2026) + GTA V launch lineup
drafts.prediction_method: Official 'biggest yet' claim anchored to GTA V station counts
drafts.draft_notes: Suggested tier: predicted. Resolves at launch (Nov 19). Verify the GTA V launch count against a primary source before publishing. Held at Oct 23 review: verify GTA V launch station count first.

drafts.title: Launch In-Game Purchases Are Upgrades, Not GTA$
drafts.value: Edition upgrades / add-on packs until Online launches
drafts.basis: Rockstar's GTA VI pages carry an 'In-Game Purchases' rating line, and PEGI's removed report noted the game is playable without buying anything. GTA Online is not live on day one (pred-vi-online-day-one), so there is no shared GTA$ economy to sell into. The likeliest launch store is the Ultimate Edition upgrade and cosmetic or vehicle packs, with GTA$ cards arriving alongside Online.
drafts.source: Rockstar rating line + PEGI (via Rockstar Intel, Oct 2 2026) + GTAVI.AI economy model
drafts.prediction_method: Rating-board signal combined with Online launch timing
drafts.draft_notes: Suggested tier: predicted. Ties into the Shark Card predictions; resolves when the in-game store opens. Promoted 2026-10-23 as predicted (owner review).

drafts.title: GTA VI Launch-Week Sales
drafts.value: ~25M copies in the first 7 days (global sell-through)
drafts.basis: Sensor Tower counts 6.45M US digital pre-orders at 45 days out, growing ~380k a week. Holding that pace to Nov 19 gives ~8.9M US digital copies at launch. US digital has been roughly 35–40% of global launch units for recent AAA releases, implying ~22–25M global pre-orders before day-one walk-in sales. GTA V sold 11.2M in its first 24 hours (2013, PS3/360 only) for comparison.
drafts.source: Sensor Tower via Rockstar Intel (Oct 21 2026) + GTA V launch record + GTAVI.AI model

prediction_range.low: 18M (pre-order pace stalls, US share higher than assumed)
prediction_range.high: 35M (late surge plus boxed and non-US over-index)

drafts.prediction_method: Pre-order run-rate extrapolation with an assumed US-digital share of global units
drafts.draft_notes: Suggested tier: predicted. Resolves when Rockstar/Take-Two announce first-week sales (press release or Q3 FY27 earnings). The US-digital share assumption is the weak link. Promoted 2026-10-23 as predicted (owner review).
